# Security Checklist: macOS Virtual Audio Driver MVP

**Purpose**: Requirement-quality gate for privacy, secrets, diagnostics, local artifacts, and consent boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are diagnostic redaction requirements complete for raw audio, transcript text, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, filesystem paths, and device identifiers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK002 Are local encrypted buffer requirements complete for retention deadline, purge state, upload state, deletion reporting, and disk pressure behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010..FR-012, Plan §Storage]
- [x] CHK003 Are consent and visible-control requirements complete for both audio-recording and transcript-only modes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015..FR-018]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what the desktop client must never store or transmit directly, including MediaScribe credentials and direct MediaScribe audio upload? [Completeness, Spec §Constitutional Requirements]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "diagnostics without secrets" clarified into explicit allowed and forbidden fields rather than left as a generic privacy statement? [Clarity, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK006 Is the boundary between local desktop capture, future server ingest, MediaScribe, and Langfuse explicit enough to prevent hidden egress in this feature? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK007 Is the local deletion truth requirement specific about desktop acknowledgement versus server purge and local expiry? [Clarity, Spec §Retention/Deletion Impact]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are transcript-only requirements consistent with audio-recording requirements for route validation, visible capture state, and stop control? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-015..FR-017]
- [x] CHK009 Are diagnostics requirements consistent across spec, plan, data model, and diagnostics contract without allowing raw content in one artifact and forbidding it in another? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Constraints, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK010 Are local buffer requirements consistent with the thin-driver boundary so persistence never becomes a driver/audio component responsibility? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036..FR-037, Data Model §LocalBufferItem]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are requirements defined for diagnostics generation when forbidden content is detected inside logs or manifests? [Coverage, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for capture behavior when disk reserve or local buffer thresholds are reached during an active meeting? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-011..FR-012]
- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for app restart while local audio is buffered, including truthful state and deletion/accounting implications? [Coverage, Spec §US3, Data Model §CaptureSession]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can the "no forbidden diagnostic content" success criterion be objectively reviewed against a concrete forbidden-field list? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK015 Can the "no silent audio loss" security/privacy condition be objectively tied to buffer thresholds and degraded/stop states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
